::: {#perfil}

PhD student at FGV EMAp, where he also earned an MSc in Mathematical Modeling and double BSc degrees in Applied Mathematics and in Data Science and AI. He works as a data scientist at Proffer, on smart pricing and custom data visualizations.

## Education

- PhD — FGV EMAp (in progress)
- MSc in Mathematical Modeling — FGV EMAp, 2023–2025
- BSc in Data Science and AI — FGV EMAp, 2021–2022
- BSc in Applied Mathematics — FGV EMAp, 2018–2021

## Interests

Machine learning, data visualization, and pricing.
